declarations.docstring: A finite function module with values in a simple module is isotypic of that type.
A submodule of finitely many copies of pairwise nonisomorphic simple modules has the same simple types, with each multiplicity bounded by the original one.
The inclusion of a submodule of a finite direct sum of simple modules is blockwise a matrix of endomorphisms with right-linearly independent rows.
A submodule of the displayed function module admits bounded multiplicities and linearly independent coordinate data satisfying the stated expansion formula.
A submodule of a displayed finite function module is equivalent to one with bounded multiplicities.
